section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Mezcali Founders to Open New Fusion Concept in Financial District: The restaurateurs behind Mexican restaurant Mezcali and American tavern the Malt House have signed a lease for a new food concept in Manhattan’s Financial District. Eoin Foyle and Darren Shore signed a 20-year, 4,744-square-foot lease in the retail component of TF Cornerstone ’s 2 Gold Street , where they will launch.

Muji, Daniel Eddy’s Winner Sign Retail Leases at Brooklyn’s Alloy Block: Two retail tenants have taken almost 13,000 square feet at a new development in Downtown Brooklyn. Japanese home goods and apparel brand Muji was the largest of the two, signing a 10-year, 10,000-square-foot lease at Alloy Development ’s 100 Flatbush Avenue , part of the larger five-building, mixed-use Alloy Block.

AI Firm Corgi to Open 24/7 Cafe at 121 East 27th Street: Alert the Queen, here come the corgis! OK, not exactly.

New York City’s First El Pollo Loco Coming to Jackson Heights in Queens: Why did the chicken cross the continent? To get to new customers on the other side.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
Why Premium Grocers Skew CMBS Delinquency Rankings: Headline CMBS delinquency rates overstate tenant risk for premium grocers due to property-level issues unrelated to supermarket performance. Large nonperforming loans are tied to urban retail condos and malls, not traditional grocery-anchored centers, distorting delinquency statistics.

Tanger Raises Outlook as Travel and Back-to-School Drive Gains: Tanger upped its annual funds from operations guidance after Q2 tenant sales rose 5% year-over-year. World Cup tourism and early back-to-school demand fueled traffic, with core FFO and revenue beating Wall Street forecasts.

Onyx Bids $934M for 117 J.C. Penney Stores in Portfolio Play: Onyx Partners has submitted a $934M offer for a 117-store J.C. Penney portfolio covering 15.7M SF across 35 states.

NYC Doubles Retail Lease Assistance Funding Amid Tight Market: New York City increased its commercial lease assistance program budget from $4M to $8M to support small business tenants. The program provides legal support for leases, renewals, and disputes, benefiting both tenants and landlords as retail rents and competition rise.
section_overviews.new_york_post:
Legendary NYC restaurant long frequented by power players dodges eviction over $89K in unpaid rent: The Big Apple hotspot was nearly evicted from its Central Park South home.

One Times Square offers panoramic views with ‘immersive’ attractions set to brighten plaza: Jamestown is opening One Times Square’s full array of “immersive” attractions to the public on Friday -- five years since the half-billion-dollar adaptive reuse of the iconic but empty former office tower was announced.

Scammers are targeting church land in latest twisted scheme to steal properties from their owners: A North Carolina church was fraudulently sold for $110,000 in what is becoming common among real estate fraud.

This shady feature makes some neighborhoods 15 degrees cooler: A single large tree can provide a cooling effect equivalent to 10 room-sized air conditioners operating for 20 hours per day, according to Forests News.

Eoin Foyle and Darren Shore signed a 20-year, 4,744-square-foot lease in the retail component of TF Cornerstone ’s 2 Gold Street , where they will launch their latest brainchild, a Hawaiian-Caribbean-Asian fusion restaurant called Solerum , according to the landlord.…

items.headline: Why Premium Grocers Skew CMBS Delinquency Rankings
items.summary: Headline CMBS delinquency rates overstate tenant risk for premium grocers due to property-level issues unrelated to supermarket performance. Large nonperforming loans are tied to urban retail condos and malls, not traditional grocery-anchored centers, distorting delinquency statistics. For CRE investors, evaluating property collateral is more useful than screening solely by grocery tenant names in CMBS analysis.…

items.headline: Tanger Raises Outlook as Travel and Back-to-School Drive Gains
items.summary: Tanger upped its annual funds from operations guidance after Q2 tenant sales rose 5% year-over-year. World Cup tourism and early back-to-school demand fueled traffic, with core FFO and revenue beating Wall Street forecasts. The outlook improvement points to resilient brick-and-mortar retail fundamentals and renewed space demand as development slows. Key Takeaways Domestic Travel and Event Tailwinds Boost Retail Tanger Inc.…

items.headline: Onyx Bids $934M for 117 J.C. Penney Stores in Portfolio Play
items.summary: Onyx Partners has submitted a $934M offer for a 117-store J.C. Penney portfolio covering 15.7M SF across 35 states. A prior deal between Onyx and the Copper Property trust failed, leading to litigation after the trust claimed the deadline was missed. This portfolio sale could gauge the appetite for legacy retail real estate, but will not disrupt J.C. Penney’s store operations due to long-term leases. Key Takeaways A Second Attempt at a Landmark Retail Deal Onyx Partners is pursuing a national J.C.…

items.headline: NYC Doubles Retail Lease Assistance Funding Amid Tight Market
items.summary: New York City increased its commercial lease assistance program budget from $4M to $8M to support small business tenants. The program provides legal support for leases, renewals, and disputes, benefiting both tenants and landlords as retail rents and competition rise. Persistently tight availability is boosting demand and asking rents, underlining the need for more accessible tenant resources in a landlord-driven market.…

items.headline: AI Firm Corgi to Open 24/7 Cafe at 121 East 27th Street
items.summary: Alert the Queen, here come the corgis! OK, not exactly. Corgi Cafe , a 24/7 coffee shop from Corgi , an artificial intelligence-powered insurance company — no, really — is getting ready to open its first location in New York City, Commercial Observer can first report. The tenant, which will operate a round-the-clock cafe selling coffee, other drinks and snacks, took 1,223 square feet of retail space at the base of 121 East 27th Street in Manhattan’s NoMad neighborhood, according to broker Meridian Capital Group .…

items.headline: Retail Corridors Pivot to Nightlife as Office Traffic Lags
items.summary: Nighttime and weekend activity now drives recovery in retail corridors as office traffic remains depressed, according to Placer.ai’s Q2 2026 report. Evening visits on Fridays and Saturdays have slightly surpassed pre-pandemic levels, but daytime foot traffic trails by 20–30%. Experience-focused tenants like restaurants and entertainment venues are offsetting declines in midday shopping visits tied to hybrid work patterns.…

items.headline: New York City’s First El Pollo Loco Coming to Jackson Heights in Queens
items.summary: Why did the chicken cross the continent? To get to new customers on the other side. Popular fast-casual grilled chicken restaurant El Pollo Loco has signed a lease to open its first-ever East Coast location in New York City, Commercial Observer has learned. El Pollo Loco signed a 10-year lease for 2,400 square feet at 37-07 82nd Street in Jackson Heights, Queens, according to tenant broker Ripco Real Estate . It is expected to open in 2027.…

items.headline: Nordstrom Rack Takes 22K SF in Wellington, Fla.
items.summary: Nordstrom Rack has signed a 22,000-square-foot lease in Wellington, Fla., the Seattle-based retailer announced Thursday. Nordstrom Rack is the discount concept run by Nordstrom . The new store, set to open in spring 2027, will be at The Shoppes at Isla Verde at 800-1020 South State Road 7 . Other tenants include Best Buy, Homesense, Total Wine & More, Petco , Old Navy, Ulta and Rack Room Shoes . Terms of the lease were not disclosed.…

items.headline: Whole Foods Signs 8K-SF Lease to Open Daily Shop at 1524 Second Avenue
items.summary: Whole Foods Market has signed a lease on the Upper East Side to open its version of a mini-mart. The Amazon -owned grocery chain closed an 8,121-square-foot deal for one of its small-scale concepts on the ground floor of ConTowers Associates LP ’s 1524 Second Avenue , also known as the Continental Towers , according to landlord broker Newmark . While the brokers did not define what kind of concept the store will be, the focus will be on prepared foods in a convenient setting.…

items.headline: Gowanus Golf Club Secures 6K SF to Open Private Club in Brooklyn’s Dumbo
items.summary: A new golf club is being teed up for Brooklyn’s Dumbo neighborhood. Gowanus Golf Club , a Brooklyn-based private indoor golf club chain, has leased approximately 6,000 square feet along the Dumbo waterfront at 215 Water Street , Commercial Observer has learned. The five-story mixed-use building between Bridge and Jay streets is owned by Pearl Realty Management , according to broker Corey Cohen , principal of the Roebling Team at Compass .…

items.headline: Selective Buyers Reshape US Retail Investment in 2026
items.summary: National retail transaction count dropped 13.8% and total dollar volume fell 21.6% from December 2025 to May 2026, according to DealGround’s new report. Cap rates increased to 6.75%, and buyers negotiated deeper discounts, with the average spread between asking and sale prices rising from 5.2% to 13.5%. The market remains active for prime properties, but increased selectivity and financing challenges are creating headwinds for B-quality assets.…

items.headline: Mermaid Inn Restaurateurs Ink 2K SF at 61 West 74th Street for New Eatery
items.summary: Restaurateurs Danny Abrams and Cindy Smith are making a splash on the Upper West Side. The couple and co-founders of New England-style seafood spot Mermaid Inn have selected 61 West 74th Street for their next venture, Commercial Observer has learned. Abrams secured the 2,300-square-foot lease, plus a basement space, at $130 per square foot, according to broker Meridian Capital Group .…

items.headline: Immigration Law Firm Manifest Law Subleases 18K SF at 902 Broadway
items.summary: The immigration attorneys at Manifest Law will be making some of their own moves, Commercial Observer has learned. The law firm signed a 18,200-square-foot sublease at Koeppel Rosen ’s 902 Broadway, where it will be taking over space previously occupied by Adaptive Security , according to tenant brokerage Nomad Group . Asking rent for the space was $75 per square foot.…

items.headline: Fintech Firm Maybern Grows to 30K SF at 10 Astor Place
items.summary: Maybern , a financial technology company that specializes in fund management solutions for private markets, has signed a long-term lease renewal at 10 Astor Place , nearly tripling its footprint in the GFP Real Estate -owned building. As part of the deal, Maybern will grow from 11,000 square feet to 30,000 square feet, renewing its lease across the building’s entire third floor and adding the entire fourth floor to its footprint, GFP announced.…

items.headline: Mall Giant Macerich Narrows Losses in Q2 Amid Stronger Leasing
items.summary: “No one is building new regional malls, and roughly 90 percent of our go-forward NOI comes from Class A assets and the best retailers of the world.” So said Jackson Hsieh , president and CEO of Macerich , early on during the mall-focused real estate investment trust’s second-quarter earnings call Tuesday afternoon. (He was referring to projected net operating income.) The observation goes a long way toward explaining the REIT’s continued turnaround.…
